Team.description: Who may sign in to Tally, and what they may do once they have. Changes apply to every phone immediately.
Team.howSummary: How Tally decides who may sign in
Team.howBody: Tally decides access by Google address. An admin invites somebody here, they sign in with that Google account, and their profile appears beside this — from then on the profile decides what they may do. Some admins are pinned by the deployment itself and cannot be changed here; that is the way back in if access is ever lost. Nobody is ever deleted here. A profile is the attribution on every register that person took, and since nothing consumes an invitation, deleting one would only let their next sign-in put them back at the rank it carries — so ending somebody’s access is what removes them, and their row moves under “No longer on the team”.
